unresolved_ambiguities.reason: The controlled context defines the actor (Security Manager) and the existence of rejection/approval orders but fails to define the taxonomy of rejection orders. unsupported_interpretations: The system raises an alert when it receives a rejection order that is specifically designated for a cancellation request.
The system raises an alert when it receives a rejection order (of any type) in the context of a cancellation request process.
